newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Banks to help Czech Agrobanka with deposits - c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Banks to help Czech Agrobanka with deposits - c.bank.

text.p: A Czech National Bank (CNB) governing board member said on Tuesday large banks would help the liquidity problems of Agrobanka a.s. by placing up to six billion crowns on deposit at the troubled bank.

"Today we have already completed a deal for two billion crowns (put on deposit at Agrobanka)," Ludek Niedermeyer, a member of the CNB's governing board, told Reuters, declining to name the party or parties involved in the deal.
CNB governor Josef Tosovsky told a news conference earlier that the central bank had instructed the country's "big banks" to prepare up to six billion crowns to help the liquidity of Agrobanka a.s..
Tosovsky did not elaborate on what form the liquidity help might take or from which source.
"We're talking about deposits," Niedermeyer said, again declining to name specifically which banks would be involved.

But the term "large banks" usually refers to the so-called "Big Four" Czech banks -- Ceska Sporitelna, Komercni Banka, Investicni a Postovni Banka and Ceskoslovensko Obchodni Banka a.s. (CSOB) -- all in which the state holds a significant state.
However, all but CSOB, have privately-held shares.

The CNB earlier on Tuesday put Agrobanka under "temporary forced administration" because of poor liquidity connected to the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s. in which Agrobanka and investors connected to both banks were heavily involved.
